Axiom: Per-group vs per-task. - **Per-group** (default, auto-dispatch): `sdd-execute` dispatches this mode automatically once `sdd-task --audit-group` reports the group `due` — every ticket of one spec, reviewed together. Input is the group: the spec path + its full ticket list (Task-IDs). Checks cross-ticket consistency too — Decision Log entries, absence of conflicting contracts between tickets of the same group — on top of each ticket's own drift. - **Per-task** (operator-manual): operator explicitly names a single Task-ID («audit TSK-NN»). Audit bounded to that one ticket's scope — no cross-ticket check. `sdd-execute` never auto-dispatches this mode; it exists for a targeted operator re-check outside the normal group cadence.
